source.snippet: We are already use Salesforce (CRM + Marketing Cloud). Our org is hosted outside Saudi Arabia. We are opening a new satellite office in Saudi Arabia. Local law (PDPL) may require Saudi customer data to stay in the country... Is Hyperforce the answer? From what I read, it moves the whole org to one country, which won't work for us.

problem_statement: Companies expanding into Saudi Arabia that already use Salesforce orgs hosted elsewhere face complex, unclear, and expensive data residency compliance requirements under PDPL, with no straightforward path to partial in-country data storage.
target_segment: IT architects and compliance officers at multinational companies opening Gulf/Saudi offices that use existing Salesforce CRM deployments.
notes: Asker is an enterprise Salesforce customer (CRM + Marketing Cloud) facing a real legal compliance deadline. This is a paid professional context — companies in this situation typically pay consultants or vendors significant sums. A consultancy or SaaS tool that maps PDPL requirements to specific Salesforce configuration paths and monitors compliance would find willing buyers.
